items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: we'd go to Mary Lou William's and John* had a- rib-joint on Seventh Avenue--

ctx.x: Then I had an opportunity...this is my day, this would be my schedule. I'd have a recording date at 9 o'clock. From 9 to 12. I'd go back home, eat breakfast, go back to bed. Wake up at 6. Come out to Mrs. Frazier's restaurant where a lot of people used to eat 'cause there were not that many places to eat. You couldn't eat in Frank's in those days, or you could, but you knew you'd have to be with some white person, all right? Go to Mrs. Frazier's and eat, after I go to Mrs. Frazier's and eat, 6 o'clock, may go…
*Mary Lou's husband at the time, John Williams, saxophonist with the Andy Kirk orchestra.
we'd go to Jimmy's Chicken Shack up on the hill, or you'd go, you know, places like that.
